_doc: Active video format family. While videos_in_family count < lock_until, every new video MUST stay in this format and reuse approved components from assets/library/components.json.

structure: Shot 1: 0-9.33s — testimonial speaker (Avatar Pro lipsync, direct camera)
Shot 2: pan or cutaway with text overlays (VRAAG / ANTWOORD or single line)
format_specs.audio: Halal nasheed bed (-13 to -16 LUFS linear) + Jolanda VO or voice-clone
format_specs.captions: Per-shot CaptionComposition with orange highlight on key words
format_specs.color_grading: Warm golden hour, +5% saturation, soft amber LUT on indoor

rationale: Lock to testimonial family for 3 more videos (total 6) so owner taste converges and component reuse compounds. After V6, evaluate switching to a different family or extending.
